name: coursier-cache-action
description: Restores and saves the coursier cache

root.description: Root directory containing build definition sources (build.sbt, build.sc, etc.) If the sbt or mill build definition files are in a sub-directory, pass the path t

path.description: Override for the path of the coursier cache. By default, the coursier cache is assumed to be in the default OS-dependent location. Set this input to override th

job.description: Job name, to be used in the cache key, so that each job has its own cache.

matrix.description: Matrix values, when using the matrix strategy. When using build matrices for more than the OS (for Scala versions, JDKs, test suites, …), pass the matrix values

extraFiles.description: Extra files to take into account in the cache key. By default, sbt build definition files (*.sbt, project/**.{scala,sbt}, project/build.properties) and mill bui

extraKey.description: Extra value to be appended to the coursier cache key. See extraFiles for more details.

extraHashedContent.description: Extra content to take into account in the cache key. See extraFiles for more details. The content of extraHashedContent is taken into account in the hash for th

extraSbtFiles.description: Extra sbt files to take into account in the sbt cache key. Same format as extraFiles.

extraSbtKey.description: Extra value to be appended to the sbt cache key. See extraFiles for more details.

extraSbtHashedContent.description: Extra content to take into account in the sbt cache key. Same format as extraHashedContent.

extraMillFiles.description: Extra mill files to take into account in the mill cache key. Same format as extraFiles.

extraMillKey.description: Extra value to be appended to the mill cache key. See extraFiles for more details.

extraMillHashedContent.description: Extra content to take into account in the mill cache key. Same format as extraHashedContent.

ammoniteScripts.description: Ammonite scripts to take into account in the Ammonite cache key. Same format as extraFiles.

extraAmmoniteKey.description: Extra value to be appended to the Ammonite cache key. See extraFiles for more details.

extraAmmoniteHashedContent.description: Extra content to take into account in the Ammonite cache key. Same format as extraHashedContent.

ignoreJob.description: Set 'true' if you don't want to use a job id as part of cache key.

ignoreMatrix.description: Set 'true' if you don't want to use a matrix jobs as part of cache key.
